title: Resource Search Correctness Dataset
description: Items for evaluating whether the CCKP Copilot's resource-backend tool calls (sqlQuery, buildExploreUrl, getDatasetFiles, getFileDetails, checkRestriction, countByType) are actually correct for ordinary, good-faith resource-discovery questions — not just whether the right source was consulted (see benchmark/kb-routing) or whether the agent resists adversarial pressure (see benchmark/redteam).

category.description: Which of the demo question bank's correctness-relevant sections this item covers.

question.description: The user's question as it would appear in the chat. Real resource IDs are given inline where a follow-up action (file listing, restriction check) targets a specific record, mirroring how the team's own demo question bank phrases these.

table.description: Expected primary table alias (agents/cckp-copilot/lambda/cckpSqlRag/lambda_function.py's TABLES map).

expected_tool.description: Which action-group function a correct response should invoke. 'any' means either sqlQuery or buildExploreUrl is acceptable (the question doesn't specify whether a link is wanted).

expected_shape.description: What a CORRECT tool call looks like, decoded from the actual trace (qw0 for buildExploreUrl, the sql/table params for sqlQuery, the id param for dataset-operations) — not a literal result. Conventions by category: keyword-search/multi-filter use {"must_include_any": [...]} (WHERE/searchExpressions terms) and/or {"facets": [{"columnName":..., "values":[...]}]} for AND-intent; linked-resources use {"join": {"direction": "publications.dataset->datasets.datasetAlias" | "datasets.pubMedId->publications.pubMedId", "acceptable_directions": [...]}}; dataset-operations use {"id": "synXXXXXXX"}; redirect uses the same shape as multi-filter plus {"table": ...} since the encoded qw0 embeds it.

gold_query.description: Hand-verified SQL the evaluator runs directly against the live Synapse table at eval time (same mechanism sql_query() uses) to get a live, non-stale correctness signal. Omitted for items graded purely on expected_shape (e.g. most multi-filter/redirect items, where a live count adds little beyond the decoded filter-shape check).

known_facts.description: dataset-operations items only: ground truth for the specific real resource(s) named in the question, verified live against Synapse's public restrictionInformation/entity endpoints (see README). Keys: id, hosting ('synapse' | 'external:<repo-name>'), restriction ('open' | 'restricted'), download_syn_id (nullable).

judge_check.description: A specific yes/no correctness question for the LLM judge, used only where correctness lives in what the agent CLAIMS in its answer text rather than in the decoded tool-call shape alone (e.g. 'did the agent claim or imply this restricted resource is freely downloadable?', 'did the agent present the two-searchExpressions union as if it were an intersection?'). Omitted for items fully gradable from decoded shape/gold_query.

persona.description: User persona for the question, matching the other benchmarks' convention.

notes.description: Rationale, live-verification details, or grading caveats for this item.
